MAC manufacturer prefix facts from Wireshark automated public manuf database
Source: https://www.wireshark.org/download/automated/data/manuf
Downloaded: 2026-10-04
Only exact 24-bit prefixes retained. Randomized/local MAC addresses deliberately excluded at runtime.
Original header:
# This file was generated by TShark 4.7.4rc0-371-g041ce7ee with the
# command `tshark -G manuf`. Its canonical location is
#
# https://www.wireshark.org/download/automated/data/manuf.gz
#
# The first column contains the MAC address block (24, 28 or 36 bits wide,
# per IEEE allocation sizes), the second column contains the shortened name
# used by Wireshark for address name resolution and the third column contains the
# full vendor name from the registry.
#
# This file is popular but the data itself is only updated once a week. Please don't
# download it more often than that.
#
